anchor: First, a disaggregated Qwen3-VL deployment must also ship the three DeepStack projections the language model consumes in its early layers (three more such tensors per image), quadrupling the payload to ≈6.4 MB per image (≈250 ms at the 121-image maximum on the default link).
claim_text: DeepStack projections quadruple payload to ~6.4 MB/image (~250 ms at 121-image max on 25 Gbps link).

adjudication.observed: handoff_gbps: 25, handoff_rtt_ms: 0.2, max_ms: 62.37, post_merge_tokens: 196, calculated_max_images: 121.0, projected_deepstack_max_handoff_ms: 248.88
adjudication.evidence: In sweeps:vision_head2k_s1, default 25 Gbps link handoff max is 62.37 ms (exactly 121.0 images of 1.6 MB). DeepStack x4 (6.4 MB/image) takes 248.88 ms (≈250 ms) for 121 images.

adjudication.observed: The current unsuperseded run has a 25 Gbps link and 62.37 ms observed maximum handoff; collector_encoder_fn has 530 valid rows, 196 tokens/image, tested n_images from 1 to 512, 0 rows at 121, and 0 DeepStack rows. v_cost_ratio has 0 current rows for the run. Across 5 non-superseded effective windows, the largest mean is 115.42304593070105 images per image-bearing request.
adjudication.evidence: The DB supports the link rate and base token count but contains no DeepStack payload/projection backing or 121-image observation, so neither the necessary four-tensor transfer nor the resulting payload and latency is established.
